primary_goal: Drive online add-to-cart clicks ('In den Warenkorb') or store pickup orders for Balea med Shampoo Ultra Sensitive.

friction_points.issue: Payment options and shipping costs are missing from the buy box area, relying on footer icons for trust badges.
friction_points.evidence: Image 1 shows 'inkl. MwSt. zzgl. Versand' without showing exact delivery fees, and preferred German payment options (Klarna, PayPal, Kauf auf Rechnung) only appear at the bottom footer in Image 10.

friction_points.issue: Significant negative customer reviews alleging product formula changes are prominent without brand responses or clear contextual clarification.
friction_points.evidence: Image 5 shows 81 1-star reviews out of 468 (3.9 total score), and Image 8 displays reviews titled 'Nicht mehr, wie es mal war' complaining about scalp irritation post-reformulation.

friction_points.issue: Critical product details for sensitive skin care (ingredients, usage instructions) are hidden inside collapsed accordions.
friction_points.evidence: Image 2 shows collapsed accordions for 'Produktmerkmale', 'Inhaltsstoffe', and 'Verwendungshinweise' requiring extra clicks to view allergen information.

friction_points.issue: Store availability check ('Verfügbarkeit in einem dm-Markt prüfen') is disconnected and visually secondary to online delivery.
friction_points.evidence: Image 2 shows 'Verfügbarkeit in einem dm-Markt prüfen' pushed outside the main primary action box shown in Image 1.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we display trusted German payment icons (PayPal, Klarna) and explicit shipping cost information directly below the 'In den Warenkorb' button, then add-to-cart rate will improve because delivery cost anxiety is reduced and payment confidence is established at the decision point.
hypotheses.change: Add payment badges (PayPal, Klarna, Invoice) and clear shipping fee text (e.g., 'Versand 4,95 € / Gratis ab 59 €') inside the main buy box.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we auto-expand or highlight the 'Inhaltsstoffe' (Ingredients) section for sensitive skin products, then conversion rate will improve because users with sensitive skin can instantly verify allergen safety without extra effort.
hypotheses.change: Set the 'Inhaltsstoffe' accordion to expanded by default or add an allergen-free key ingredient box near the top summary.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we integrate store pickup options ('2 Std. Express-Abholung im Markt') directly inside the primary buy box alongside online shipping, then overall product conversions will increase because local omnichannel shoppers can immediately choose their preferred delivery channel.
hypotheses.change: Combine 'Online bestellen' and 'Im dm-Markt abholen' into a unified toggle/selector inside the buy box.

quick_wins: Add PayPal and Klarna payment icons right below the 'In den Warenkorb' button.
Show exact standard shipping costs alongside 'zzgl. Versand' in the buy box.
Default-expand the 'Inhaltsstoffe' accordion section for sensitive skin products.
uncertainties: Mobile viewport behavior and visual stack order of the buy box.
Exact distribution of online delivery sales versus 2-hour store pickup orders.
Whether the product formulation was recently changed or if negative reviews stem from a temporary batch issue.
